paper_title: The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2
caption: Distribution of Content Types in the DODa
model_annotation: The chart represents the distribution of content types in the DODa dataset, displaying the proportion of various categories. The chart is divided into six slices. The categories include Moroccan Names (red), which is very small and makes up less than 1%; Semantic Categories (purple), also very small and less than 1%; Syntactic Roles (orange), occupying around 16% with a count of 23,108; Translated Sentences (yellow), the largest slice at approximately 32% with a count of 45,387; Extra + Augmented Data (blue), making up around 21% with a count of 30,000; and Pending Translations (green), representing about 30% with a count of 43,000. A legend is provided to the right of the chart, associating each category with its corresponding color. The counts are labeled inside each slice. The chart is presented in a donut style, with the slices appearing in a particular order based on their size.
